name: dnd-dm-tools
description: A plugin for Obsidian.md with DnD 5e DM tools in russian.

scripts.build: npm run copy:assets && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run owlbear:build
scripts.pages:build: npm run owlbear:build && shx rm -rf .pages && mkdir -p .pages/owlbear-extension && shx cp -r owlbear-extension/dist/* .pages/owlbear-extension
scripts.release: npm run build && mkdir -p .release/dnd-dm-tools && cp main.js manifest.json sql-wasm.wasm styles.css .release/dnd-dm-tools && shx rm -rf .release/dnd-dm-tools/owlbear-extension && mkdir -p .release/dnd-dm-tools/owlbear-extension && shx cp -r owlbear-extension/dist/* .release/dnd-dm-tools/owlbear-extension
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: VladBytsyuk
